name: Director Callan Deyrus
notes: Entity record created 2026-08-09 to close a structural gap: this character existed ONLY as a charforge capsule, with no entity record, while being referenced by entity records (e.g. vessel crew_ids / commanding_officer_id). It therefore dangled from the entity graph and was silently omitted by every tool that indexes entity records. Core fields derive from the capsule, which is the authoritative existing canon; nothing was invented.

naming_exemption.reason: Name preserved verbatim from the committed charforge capsule (canon/L2/entities/callan_deyrus/capsule/identity.json).

capsule_binding_note: Explicit bridge between the two identifier namespaces. Relational fields across canon (crew_ids, commanding_officer_id, task_group_commander_id) refer to this entity by its CAPSULE id "callan_deyrus", while the record identity is "char_callan_deyrus". Before this field the two were connected only by stripping a prefix and hoping; tools/canon_reference_integrity.py now checks the bridge instead of guessing it.

agency_name_conflict.summary: Another canon record heads the same agency under its superseded draft name (GSB). Unresolved; this record is unchanged and retains the canonical UIB form.
